task_spec: Add service_fee(amount): the fee is 3% of amount, but per our billing agreement it must be rounded UP to the next whole 5 cents (nickel). E.g. amount 4000 -> 3% = 120 -> already a nickel -> 120; amount 4100 -> 123 -> rounded up to 125.

bugs.description: service_fee uses round() to the nearest cent, but the spec requires rounding UP to the next 5 cents (nickel). Correct: math.ceil(amount*FEE_BPS/10000/5)*5. Rounding to the nearest cent is a perfectly normal default; only the arbitrary nickel-up billing rule (spec only) makes it wrong.

provenance.note: arbitrary rule lives ONLY in task_spec; not derivable from code or world knowledge
